mechanism: Pantoprazole may inhibit CYP2C19, potentially increasing cenobamate exposure, while cenobamate induces multiple CYP450 enzymes including CYP2C19, which may reduce pantoprazole effectiveness.
action: Monitor cenobamate efficacy and pantoprazole effectiveness; consider alternative PPI or dose adjustment if acid suppression is inadequate; therapeutic drug monitoring of cenobamate may be warranted.
